# Flutter Leaf Kit (Umbrella) - LLM Documentation

Re-exports all Leaf packages for single-import convenience. No unique code — all functionality comes from sub-packages.

## Import Guide

### All-in-one Import

```dart
import 'package:flutter_leaf_kit/flutter_leaf_kit.dart';
```

Includes: leaf_common, leaf_component, leaf_route, leaf_network, leaf_platform, leaf_state

### Per-package Import

| Import | Package | Description |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| `flutter_leaf_kit/flutter_leaf_kit_common.dart` | leaf_common | Utilities, extensions, logging, date/time, data models |
| `flutter_leaf_kit/flutter_leaf_kit_component.dart` | leaf_component | UI components (Atomic Design) |
| `flutter_leaf_kit/flutter_leaf_kit_route.dart` | leaf_route | Page navigation, modals |
| `flutter_leaf_kit/flutter_leaf_kit_network.dart` | leaf_network | HTTP communication (Dio) |
| `flutter_leaf_kit/flutter_leaf_kit_platform.dart` | leaf_platform | Location, Maps, WebView, app/device/file/permission |
| `flutter_leaf_kit/flutter_leaf_kit_state.dart` | leaf_state | BLoC state management |

### Legacy Aliases

| Import | Redirects to |
|--------|-------------|
| `flutter_leaf_kit/flutter_leaf_kit_datetime.dart` | leaf_common |
| `flutter_leaf_kit/flutter_leaf_kit_manager.dart` | leaf_platform |

## Sub-package Documentation

- [leaf_common](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_common/llms.txt): Common utilities, extensions, date/time, data models
- [leaf_component](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_component/llms.txt): UI component library (Atomic Design)
- [leaf_network](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_network/llms.txt): HTTP networking (Dio)
- [leaf_platform](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_platform/llms.txt): Platform services
- [leaf_state](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_state/llms.txt): BLoC state management
